purpose: Validate an ex-ante Taiwan policy-expectation source lane without inferring expectations from market reaction and without opening equity-return outcomes.

frozenExpectationContract: Preserve the full ex-ante forecast distribution whenever available; do not choose mean/median/mode after observing the decision or returns.
Expectation timestamp must precede the decision timestamp/date. Post-decision analyst commentary is not an expectation observation.
Realized policy and expected policy must share compatible units and decision object.
If a categorical policy has no natural numeric metric, store scenario probabilities/distribution rather than inventing a scalar surprise.
A market price move cannot back-solve the missing expectation.
Future prospective captures must preserve capturedAt and immutable source/version evidence.
falsification: Both historical CBC witnesses realized the modal expectation; they prove source feasibility, not that policy events create alpha.
Two dates are insufficient for any equity-return, half-life, sector-transmission or trading conclusion.
CBC macro-state interpretation remains owned by D13; D17 owns event identity, expectation/surprise clock and transmission evidence. No double factor vote.
No expectation functional may be optimized after observing equity returns.

maturityDecision.basis: Two independent Taiwan decisions have dated ex-ante expectation distributions from a durable news source and compatible official CBC realization records. This satisfies Taiwan PIT/source feasibility only.

exactNext: Prospectively archive ex-ante expectation distributions with capturedAt on future independent Taiwan policy decisions; include non-modal/unexpected outcomes when naturally observed; preregister surprise functional, event zero, horizons, D13 macro controls and equity outcomes before any L4 claim.
